newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: POLL - Bank/Portugal seen leaving rates unchanged.
newsitem.headline: POLL - Bank/Portugal seen leaving rates unchanged.

text.p: The Bank of Portugal is expected to leave all of its official rates unchanged on Monday on the eve of a new commercial bank accounting period, according to a poll of seven economists of brokers and banks polled by Reuters.
All the economists said they believed that the Bank of Portugal had room to cut official rates further this year.
The repurchase pact rate is presently 6.50 percent, the absorption rate used to drain funds from the money market is 6.20 percent and the emergency lending rate is 8.30 percent.
The economists' replies are listed below:
1. Will the Bank of Portugal cut the repo rate next week?
2. If the answer to question 1. is affirmative, how how much will the Bank of Portugal cut the repo rate?
3. Will the Bank of Portugal cut the absorption rate next week?
4. If the answer to question 3 is affirmative, by how much will the Bank of Portugal lower rates?
5. Has the Bank of Portugal room to cut rates further this year?

NOTE: The following companies took part in the compilation of the poll: IMF-Informacao de Mercados Financeiros; Siemca-Sociedade Mediadora de Capitais; Banco Portugues de Investimento; Banco de Comercio e Industria; Banco Finantia; Banco Mello Investimentos; and Fincor.
